shortBio.en: AC/DC rhythm guitarist; right-hand eighth-note grind as the band’s engine until 2014.
shortBio.zh: AC/DC 节奏吉他；右手八分碾磨是乐队引擎，直至 2014。

body.en:
Born 1953. Rhythm parts define AC/DC more than solos. Exits mid-2010s for health; nephew Stevie Young covers later tours.

If you mute Malcolm’s track, the ‘AC/DC feel’ usually collapses.
body.zh:
1953 年生。节奏分声部比 Solo 更定义 AC/DC。2010 年代中期因健康退出；侄子 Stevie Young 顶后期巡演。

Mute 掉 Malcolm 的轨，‘AC/DC 手感’通常一起塌。

note.en: Core rhythm writer through the classic catalog.
note.zh: 贯穿经典目录的核心节奏写手。
